source.text: Παρακαλῶ οὖν ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, διὰ τῶν οἰκτιρμῶν τοῦ θεοῦ παραστῆσαι τὰ σώματα ὑμῶν θυσίαν ζῶσαν ἁγίαν εὐάρεστον τῷ θεῷ, τὴν λογικὴν λατρείαν ὑμῶν·

records.literal_gloss: I urge therefore you, brothers, through the compassions of the God to present the bodies of you [as] a sacrifice living, holy, well-pleasing to the God, the reasonable worship of you;

en.L: I urge you therefore, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies [as] a living sacrifice, holy, well pleasing to God, your reasonable worship;
en.B: So, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, I appeal to you by the mercies of God: offer your bodies to God as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. That is your reasonable worship.
en.R: So, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, God has shown you such great mercy. Because of it, I urge you to give your bodies, your whole selves, to God as a living sacrifice. Such a sacrifice is holy, and it pleases {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. This is the worship that truly makes sense.

es.L: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} exhorto, pues, hermanos, por las misericordias de Dios, a presentar {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cuerpos [como] sacrificio vivo, santo, agradable a Dios, {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} culto razonable;
es.B: Así pues, hermanos, {{plural_you:les|os}} ruego por las misericordias de Dios: {{plural_you:ofrezcan|ofreced}} a Dios {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cuerpos como sacrificio vivo, santo y agradable a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Ese es {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} culto razonable.
es.R: Así que, hermanos, Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} ha mostrado una misericordia muy grande. Por eso {{plural_you:les|os}} pido que {{plural_you:entreguen|entreguéis}} a Dios {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cuerpos, todo {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} ser, como sacrificio vivo. Un sacrificio así es santo, y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} agrada. Esta es la adoración que de verdad tiene sentido.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo nawaomba, ndugu, kwa rehema za Mungu, mtoe miili yenu [kama] dhabihu hai, takatifu, inayompendeza Mungu, ibada yenu ya busara;
sw.B: Basi ndugu, nawasihi kwa rehema za Mungu: mtoe miili yenu kwa Mungu kama dhabihu hai, takatifu na inayompendeza. Hiyo ndiyo ibada yenu ya busara.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo ndugu, Mungu amewaonyesha rehema kubwa mno. Kwa sababu hiyo, nawaomba mtoe miili yenu, yaani maisha yenu yote, kwa Mungu kama dhabihu hai. Dhabihu ya namna hiyo ni takatifu, nayo inampendeza. Hii ndiyo njia ya kumwabudu Mungu inayoleta maana kweli.

fr.L: Je vous exhorte donc, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, par les miséricordes de Dieu, à présenter vos corps [comme] un sacrifice vivant, saint, agréable à Dieu, votre culte raisonnable ;
fr.B: Ainsi donc, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, je vous le demande au nom des miséricordes de Dieu : offrez vos corps à Dieu comme un sacrifice vivant, saint et qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} plaît. C’est là votre culte raisonnable.
fr.R: Ainsi, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, Dieu vous a montré une si grande miséricorde ! C’est pourquoi je vous demande avec insistance de donner à Dieu votre corps, tout votre être, comme un sacrifice vivant. Un tel sacrifice est saint, et il {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} plaît. Voilà la façon d’adorer Dieu qui a vraiment du sens.

ko.L: 그러므로 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나는 하나님의 긍휼하심을 힘입어 여러분에게 권합니다. 여러분의 몸을 살아 있는 제물, 거룩하고 하나님께서 기쁘게 받으실 제물로 드리십시오. [이것이] 여러분의 합당한 예배입니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 하나님의 자비에 힘입어 여러분에게 간곡히 부탁합니다. 여러분의 몸을 하나님께 살아 있는 제물로 바치십시오. 그 제물은 거룩하고, 하나님께서 기쁘게 받으시는 것입니다. 이것이 여러분이 드려야 할 합당한 예배입니다.
ko.R: 그러므로 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 하나님께서 여러분에게 이처럼 큰 자비를 베푸셨으니, 나는 여러분에게 부탁합니다. 여러분의 몸, 곧 여러분 자신을 하나님께 살아 있는 제물로 드리십시오. 그런 제물은 거룩하고, 하나님을 기쁘시게 합니다. 이것이야말로 참으로 이치에 맞는 예배입니다.

vi.L: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi nài khuyên anh chị em, bởi những sự thương xót của Đức Chúa Trời, hãy dâng thân thể anh chị em [làm] của lễ sống, thánh, đẹp lòng Đức Chúa Trời, [là] sự thờ phượng hợp lẽ của anh chị em;
vi.B: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, bởi lòng thương xót của Đức Chúa Trời, tôi nài khuyên anh chị em: hãy dâng thân thể mình cho Đức Chúa Trời làm của lễ sống, thánh và đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Đó là sự thờ phượng hợp lẽ của anh chị em.
vi.R: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, Đức Chúa Trời đã tỏ lòng thương xót lớn lao đối với anh chị em. Vì thế, tôi nài khuyên anh chị em hãy dâng thân thể mình, tức là cả con người mình, cho Đức Chúa Trời làm một của lễ sống. Của lễ ấy thánh và đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Đây là cách thờ phượng thật sự hợp lý.

decisions.choice: therefore: what follows rests on everything Paul has said so far
alternatives: a link to the end of chapter 11 only
decisions.reason: The "therefore" (οὖν) turns from what God has done (chapters 1-11) to how those who have received it should live. The nearest ground is God's mercy to Jews and Gentiles alike in 11:30-32.

decisions.choice: by the mercies of God: Paul appeals on the basis of God's mercy
alternatives: through the mercies of God, as the means of presenting
decisions.reason: With διὰ a request is made by appeal to something, as in 15:30 and 2 Corinthians 10:1. The plural "mercies" follows a Hebrew way of speaking of God's compassion, and points back to the mercy of 11:30-32.

decisions.choice: your bodies: your whole selves, as people who live and act in a body
decisions.reason: Romans uses "body" for the person as one who acts in the world (6:12-13, where "your members" and "yourselves" are offered to God). The body is not left out: the offering is lived out in what the body does.

decisions.choice: a living sacrifice: unlike an animal killed on the altar, this offering keeps living
decisions.reason: In the temple, a sacrifice was an animal put to death and offered whole to God. Paul's readers knew that practice, Jewish and pagan alike. He uses its language ("present", "holy", "pleasing") for a life given to God that goes on living.

decisions.choice: worship that is reasonable and fitting: the worship that makes sense for people who understand what God has done
alternatives: spiritual worship, as opposed to outward ritual
decisions.reason: The adjective λογικός comes from the word for reason or word. It describes what is rational and fitting for thinking beings, and it was also used of worship offered with the mind rather than by animal sacrifice, so "spiritual" is a possible sense. The word λατρεία means worship, especially service at the temple. The phrase stands beside the whole act of offering oneself: that act is the worship.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: Paul writes to the whole church, women and men; the reader can choose the traditional "brothers".

decisions.choice: reasonable worship
decisions.reason: "Reasonable" keeps the link to thinking that the Greek word has, and "worship" is clearer today than "service" for temple language. Readable says what it means: the worship that truly makes sense.

decisions.choice: because God has shown you such great mercy
decisions.reason: Readable turns the appeal into a reason, which is what "by the mercies of God" means here.

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: As through Romans: each plural "you" and its verb is a reader setting, ustedes (the default) or vosotros.

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: As at 1:13: "hermanos" already includes the sisters, so Spanish has no gender span on it in this chapter.

decisions.choice: culto razonable
decisions.reason: "Razonable" keeps the link with reason that the meaning decision describes and reads as "fitting"; "espiritual" would choose the other possible sense. Readable says what it means: "la adoración que de verdad tiene sentido".

decisions.choice: ndugu, no setting
alternatives: ndugu wa kiume na wa kike
decisions.reason: As at 1:13: "ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, so Swahili has no gender span in this chapter.

decisions.choice: ibada yenu ya busara
decisions.reason: "Busara" is good sense and sound judgment, which keeps the link with reason that the meaning decision describes; "ya kiroho" (spiritual) would choose the other possible sense. Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} for the readers (for chapters 12-16)
decisions.reason: As in English, Paul addresses the whole church, men and women; "frères" stays available as the traditional form. Words that agree with it need no span.

decisions.choice: votre culte raisonnable
decisions.reason: The adjective means worship that fits reason, the worship that makes sense for people who understand God's mercy (the footnoted meaning decision). "Spirituel" would lose the link with reason; Readable says it plainly: "la façon d’adorer Dieu qui a vraiment du sens".

decisions.choice: the exhortations in 합쇼체 ("-십시오") with "{{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분", as through the letter; no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: As settled at 1:1 and 1:13. Paul's commands to the church keep the letter's 합쇼체 through chapters 12-13; Korean has no capital letters for the deity_pronoun setting to change.

decisions.choice: "긍휼하심" (L); "자비" (B, R) for the mercies of God
decisions.reason: The noun is from the verb Literal renders "긍휼히 여기다" at 9:15; Balanced and Readable use "자비", the letter's word for God's mercy at those levels.

decisions.choice: "합당한 예배" (L, B); "참으로 이치에 맞는 예배" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the adjective as reasonable and fitting, the worship that makes sense for people who understand what God has done, and footnotes "spiritual". "영적 예배" is the familiar Korean wording and is given as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "dâng" at every level; "của lễ sống"
decisions.reason: The verb is the one rendered "dâng" in 6:13-19 (put at someone's disposal), and here it is used of an offering at the altar (m4), so "dâng" is kept at every level, Readable included. "Của lễ" is the word for an offering in 3:25; "sinh tế" names only an animal killed.

decisions.choice: "sự thờ phượng hợp lẽ" (L, B); "cách thờ phượng thật sự hợp lý" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the phrase as worship that is reasonable and fitting, with a footnote for "spiritual". "Hợp lẽ" says it fits what God has done; "thuộc linh" would choose the footnoted sense, and is kept for a different Greek word (1:11, 7:14).

source.text: καὶ μὴ συσχηματίζεσθε τῷ αἰῶνι τούτῳ, ἀλλὰ μεταμορφοῦσθε τῇ ἀνακαινώσει τοῦ νοός, εἰς τὸ δοκιμάζειν ὑμᾶς τί τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ, τὸ ἀγαθὸν καὶ εὐάρεστον καὶ τέλειον.

records.literal_gloss: And not be conformed to the age this, but be transformed by the renewal of the mind, for the to test you what [is] the will of the God, the good and well-pleasing and perfect.

en.L: And do not be conformed to this age, but be transformed by the renewal of [your] mind, so that you may test what the will of God [is], the good and well pleasing and perfect.
en.B: Do not let this present age press you into its mold, but be changed through and through as your mind is made new. Then you will be able to test and recognize the will of God: what is good and pleasing and perfect.
en.R: Do not let the ways of this present age shape your life. Let God change you from the inside by making your mind new. Then you will be able to find out what God wants. You will know what is good, what pleases {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and what is perfect.

es.L: Y no {{plural_you:tomen|toméis}} la forma de esta era, sino {{plural_you:sean|sed}} transformados por la renovación de la mente, para que {{plural_you:examinen|examinéis}} cuál [es] la voluntad de Dios, lo bueno y agradable y perfecto.
es.B: No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que esta era presente {{plural_you:los|os}} meta en su molde; al contrario, {{plural_you:déjense|dejaos}} transformar por completo a medida que {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} mente se renueva. Entonces {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} capaces de examinar y reconocer la voluntad de Dios: lo que es bueno, agradable y perfecto.
es.R: No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que las costumbres de esta era presente den forma a {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} vida. {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} que Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} cambie por dentro, renovando {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} manera de pensar. Entonces {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} descubrir lo que Dios quiere. {{plural_you:Sabrán|Sabréis}} qué es bueno, qué {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} agrada y qué es perfecto.

sw.L: Na msijifananishe na zama hizi, bali mbadilishwe kupitia kufanywa mpya kwa akili [yenu], ili mweze kupima mapenzi ya Mungu [ni] nini, yaliyo mema na yanayompendeza na kamili.
sw.B: Msikubali zama hizi za sasa ziwafinyange kwa umbo lake, bali mbadilishwe kabisa kadiri akili zenu zinavyofanywa mpya. Ndipo mtaweza kupima na kutambua mapenzi ya Mungu: yaliyo mema, yanayompendeza na yaliyo kamili.
sw.R: Msikubali mienendo ya zama hizi za sasa iunde maisha yenu. Mruhusuni Mungu awabadilishe kutoka ndani kwa kufanya upya jinsi mnavyofikiri. Ndipo mtaweza kujua kile Mungu anachotaka. Mtajua lililo jema, linalompendeza na lililo kamili.

fr.L: Et ne vous conformez pas à cet âge, mais soyez transformés par le renouvellement de [votre] pensée, afin que vous discerniez quelle [est] la volonté de Dieu, ce qui est bon, agréable et parfait.
fr.B: Ne laissez pas l’époque présente vous couler dans son moule, mais laissez-vous transformer de fond en comble par le renouvellement de votre pensée. Vous pourrez alors discerner et reconnaître la volonté de Dieu : ce qui est bon, agréable et parfait.
fr.R: Ne laissez pas les habitudes de l’époque où nous vivons façonner votre vie. Laissez Dieu vous changer de l’intérieur en renouvelant votre façon de penser. Vous pourrez alors découvrir ce que Dieu veut. Vous saurez ce qui est bon, ce qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} plaît et ce qui est parfait.

ko.L: 그리고 이 시대의 틀에 맞추어지지 말고, 마음이 새로워짐으로 변화되십시오. 그리하여 여러분이 하나님의 뜻이 무엇인지, 곧 무엇이 선하고 기쁘게 받으실 만하고 완전한지 시험하여 [알게 하십시오].
ko.B: 이 시대가 여러분을 그 틀에 맞추어 찍어 내지 못하게 하십시오. 오히려 마음이 새로워져서 속속들이 변화되십시오. 그러면 무엇이 하나님의 뜻인지, 곧 무엇이 선하고 하나님께서 기뻐하시며 완전한 것인지 분별하여 알 수 있을 것입니다.
ko.R: 지금 이 세상의 방식이 여러분의 삶을 만들어 가지 못하게 하십시오. 하나님께서 여러분의 생각을 새롭게 하셔서, 여러분을 속에서부터 바꾸시게 하십시오. 그러면 여러분은 하나님께서 원하시는 것이 무엇인지 알 수 있을 것입니다. 무엇이 선한지, 무엇이 하나님을 기쁘시게 하는지, 무엇이 완전한지 알게 될 것입니다.

vi.L: Và đừng rập khuôn theo đời này, nhưng hãy được biến đổi bởi sự đổi mới của tâm trí, để anh chị em thử nghiệm [xem] ý muốn của Đức Chúa Trời là gì: điều tốt lành, đẹp lòng và trọn vẹn.
vi.B: Đừng để đời này nhào nặn anh chị em theo khuôn của nó, nhưng hãy để mình được biến đổi hoàn toàn khi tâm trí anh chị em được đổi mới. Bấy giờ anh chị em sẽ có thể thử nghiệm và nhận biết ý muốn của Đức Chúa Trời: điều gì là tốt lành, đẹp lòng và trọn vẹn.
vi.R: Đừng để lối sống của đời này uốn nắn đời sống anh chị em. Hãy để Đức Chúa Trời thay đổi anh chị em từ bên trong bằng cách làm mới tâm trí anh chị em. Bấy giờ anh chị em sẽ có thể tìm biết điều Đức Chúa Trời muốn. Anh chị em sẽ biết điều gì là tốt, điều gì đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và điều gì là trọn vẹn.

decisions.choice: this age: the present world order, in contrast with the age to come
alternatives: this world, as the created world
decisions.reason: Jewish teaching spoke of "this age" and "the age to come". Paul uses τῷ αἰῶνι τούτῳ for life as it is shaped apart from God (1 Corinthians 2:6, Galatians 1:4), not for the created world as such.

decisions.choice: be conformed ... be transformed: both are present commands, an ongoing process
decisions.reason: Both verbs are present imperatives in the passive or middle: "stop letting yourselves be shaped" and "keep being changed". The word μεταμορφόομαι is used for the transfiguration of Jesus (Mark 9:2) and for believers being changed into his image (2 Corinthians 3:18): a change from within, while συσχηματίζομαι means fitting to an outward pattern.

decisions.choice: the renewing of the mind is God's work in the believer
alternatives: a renewal believers achieve by their own effort
decisions.reason: The passive "be transformed" and the word "renewal" point to God as the one who changes people; the same word is used of the renewal by the Holy Spirit in Titus 3:5. The mind that 1:28 calls unfit is made new.

decisions.choice: test and approve: discern by testing, and then accept
decisions.reason: The word δοκιμάζω means to test something and, having tested it, to recognize it as genuine (as in 2:18 and 1 Thessalonians 5:21).

decisions.choice: the good, pleasing and perfect: what God's will is, said in three words
alternatives: three adjectives describing God's will: his will, which is good, pleasing and perfect
decisions.reason: The three words can be nouns ("what is good ...") or describe "the will of God". The meaning is nearly the same: God's will is what is good, pleasing to him and complete. "Pleasing" is the same word as in verse 1, pleasing to God.

decisions.choice: be changed through and through / let God change you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use plain words for the change; Readable names God as the one who changes, as the passive implies (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: what pleases him
decisions.reason: Readable says whom the will pleases, as in verse 1.

decisions.choice: esta era
decisions.reason: "Siglo", the word of older Spanish Bibles, now means a hundred years, and "mundo" would suggest the created world, which the meaning decision rules out. "Era" is a period of time with its own ways.

decisions.choice: zama hizi
decisions.reason: "Dunia" and "ulimwengu" suggest the created world, which the meaning decision rules out. "Zama" is an age or era, the present time with its ways, set against the age to come.

decisions.choice: cet âge (L); l’époque présente (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is the present age of the world, set against the age to come (meaning decision). "Ce siècle" is old church French for it and now means a hundred years; "ce monde" would blur it with the separate word for the world.

decisions.choice: "틀에 맞추어지다" (L, B); "... 방식이 삶을 만들어 가다" (R); "변화되다" (L, B); "속에서부터 바꾸다" (R)
decisions.reason: The first verb is about taking on a pattern or mold, the second about a change from within; Korean gives each its own picture. Both are present commands for an ongoing process (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "마음" (L, B), "생각" (R) for the mind, as at 7:22-25; "시험하여 알다" (L); "분별하여 알다" (B); "알다" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to discern by testing and then accept (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "đời này" at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek word is "age": the present world order set against the age to come (m1). "Đời này" is the Vietnamese for this present life and age; "thế gian" is kept for the world (kosmos), a different word, and "thời đại" would sound like a modern period of history.

decisions.choice: "rập khuôn" (L), "nhào nặn ... theo khuôn" (B); "được biến đổi" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The first verb is to be pressed into a shape, the second to be changed in form (m2). "Khuôn" (a mould) keeps the first picture; "biến đổi" is a change of the whole form, stronger than "thay đổi", which Readable uses.

source.text: Λέγω γὰρ διὰ τῆς χάριτος τῆς δοθείσης μοι παντὶ τῷ ὄντι ἐν ὑμῖν μὴ ὑπερφρονεῖν παρ’ ὃ δεῖ φρονεῖν, ἀλλὰ φρονεῖν εἰς τὸ σωφρονεῖν, ἑκάστῳ ὡς ὁ θεὸς ἐμέρισεν μέτρον πίστεως.

records.literal_gloss: I say for through the grace the having been given to me to everyone the being among you not to think beyond what it is necessary to think, but to think toward the to think soberly, to each as the God has apportioned a measure of faith.

en.L: For through the grace given to me I say to everyone who is among you not to think too highly [of yourselves], beyond what you ought to think, but to think so as to think soberly, as God has apportioned to each a measure of faith.
en.B: By the grace given to me I tell each one of you: do not rate yourself higher than you should. Let your thinking be sober and sensible instead, in keeping with the measure of faith that God has assigned to each of you.
en.R: God in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace has given me my work as an apostle. So I tell each of you: Do not think you are more important than you really are. Be sensible about yourself. Judge yourself by the measure of faith that God has given you.

es.L: Porque por la gracia que me fue dada digo a todo el que está entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que no piense [de sí] más alto de lo que debe pensar, sino que piense de modo que piense con cordura, según Dios ha repartido a cada uno una medida de fe.
es.B: Por la gracia que se me ha dado, digo a cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: que nadie se valore más de lo debido; que piense, más bien, con sobriedad y sensatez, de acuerdo con la medida de fe que Dios ha asignado a cada uno.
es.R: Dios, en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia, me ha dado mi trabajo de apóstol. Por eso {{plural_you:les|os}} digo a cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: No {{plural_you:se crean|os creáis}} más importantes de lo que realmente {{plural_you:son|sois}}. {{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} con sensatez acerca de {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}}. Cada uno debe valorarse según la medida de fe que Dios le ha dado.

sw.L: Kwa maana kupitia neema niliyopewa namwambia kila mmoja aliye kati yenu asijifikirie kupita anavyopaswa kufikiri, bali afikiri kwa namna ya kufikiri kwa kiasi, kwa kadiri Mungu alivyompimia kila mmoja kipimo cha imani.
sw.B: Kwa neema niliyopewa, ninamwambia kila mmoja wenu: usijione kuwa bora kuliko unavyopaswa. Badala yake, fikiri kwa kiasi na kwa busara, kulingana na kipimo cha imani ambacho Mungu amempa kila mmoja.
sw.R: Mungu kwa neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} amenipa kazi yangu ya utume. Kwa hiyo namwambia kila mmoja wenu: Usijione kuwa mtu muhimu kuliko ulivyo kweli. Ujifikirie kwa busara. Ujipime kwa kipimo cha imani ambacho Mungu amekupa.

fr.L: Car, par la grâce qui m’a été donnée, je dis à chacun de ceux qui sont parmi vous de ne pas penser [de soi] plus haut qu’il ne faut penser, mais de penser de manière à penser sobrement, selon que Dieu a donné en partage à chacun une mesure de foi.
fr.B: Par la grâce qui m’a été donnée, je dis à chacun de vous : ne vous estimez pas plus haut qu’il ne faut. Que votre pensée soit plutôt sobre et sensée, à la mesure de la foi que Dieu a attribuée à chacun.
fr.R: Dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, Dieu m’a confié mon travail d’apôtre. C’est pourquoi je dis à chacun de vous : ne vous croyez pas plus important que vous ne l’êtes vraiment. Soyez raisonnables dans la façon dont vous vous voyez. Jugez-vous d’après la mesure de foi que Dieu vous a donnée.

ko.L: 나는 나에게 주어진 은혜를 통하여 여러분 가운데 있는 모든 사람에게 말합니다. 마땅히 생각해야 할 것을 넘어 [자기를] 높이 생각하지 말고, 건전하게 생각하도록 생각하십시오. 하나님께서 각 사람에게 믿음의 분량을 나누어 주신 대로 [하십시오].
ko.B: 나는 하나님께서 내게 주신 은혜에 힘입어 여러분 각 사람에게 말합니다. 자기를 실제보다 높게 평가하지 마십시오. 오히려 하나님께서 각자에게 나누어 주신 믿음의 분량에 따라 분별 있게 생각하십시오.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 은혜를 베푸셔서 나에게 사도의 일을 맡기셨습니다. 그래서 나는 여러분 각 사람에게 말합니다. 자기를 실제보다 더 중요한 사람이라고 생각하지 마십시오. 자기 자신에 대해 분별 있게 생각하십시오. 하나님께서 여러분에게 주신 믿음의 분량을 기준으로 자신을 판단하십시오.

vi.L: Vì bởi ân điển đã ban cho tôi, tôi nói với mỗi người ở giữa anh chị em: đừng nghĩ [về mình] quá cao hơn điều phải nghĩ, nhưng hãy nghĩ sao cho có chừng mực, tùy theo lượng đức tin Đức Chúa Trời đã phân chia cho mỗi người.
vi.B: Bởi ân điển đã được ban cho tôi, tôi nói với mỗi người trong anh chị em: đừng đánh giá mình cao hơn mức nên có. Trái lại, hãy suy nghĩ cách tỉnh táo và chừng mực, tùy theo lượng đức tin mà Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho mỗi người.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời, bởi ân điển của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đã giao cho tôi công việc của một sứ đồ. Vì vậy tôi nói với mỗi người trong anh chị em: Đừng nghĩ mình quan trọng hơn thực tế. Hãy nhìn bản thân mình cách khôn ngoan. Hãy đánh giá mình theo lượng đức tin mà Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho anh chị em.

decisions.choice: the grace given to me: God's gift of Paul's calling as an apostle
alternatives: God's kindness to Paul in general
decisions.reason: Paul speaks of "the grace given to me" for his calling to be an apostle to the Gentiles (1:5, 15:15-16, Galatians 2:9). He speaks with that authority, and in the same breath reminds them that everything anyone has is given.

decisions.choice: a play on words: do not think too highly of yourself, but think in a sober, sensible way
decisions.reason: Paul uses four related words built on φρονέω, "to think": ὑπερφρονεῖν, φρονεῖν, φρονεῖν, σωφρονεῖν. The last means to think with self-control and sound judgment, the opposite of conceit.

decisions.choice: a measure of faith: the faith God has given to each, by which each should judge himself or herself
alternatives: the same standard of faith for all, by which all are measured
different amounts of faith given to each person
decisions.reason: "Measure" can be a standard to measure by or an amount measured out. If it is a standard, all believers are measured by the same faith in Christ and none can boast. If it is an amount, God has given each a different share, as with the gifts in verses 6-8. Both readings exclude self-importance: what each has, God gave.

decisions.choice: do not rate yourself higher than you should
alternatives: not to think more highly than one ought to think
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the idea of overrating oneself in plain words; the play on words is shown at Literal.

decisions.choice: God in his grace has given me my work as an apostle
alternatives: through the grace given to me
decisions.reason: Readable says what the grace given to Paul is, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: penser plus haut ... penser ... penser sobrement
alternatives: avoir une trop haute opinion de soi ... être modeste
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the four forms of the verb "to think" so the play on words (meaning decision) shows; Balanced and Readable give the sense.

decisions.choice: Literal repeats "생각" four times ("높이 생각하다 ... 생각해야 할 ... 건전하게 생각하도록 생각하다")
decisions.reason: The Greek plays on one root for thinking (meaning decision); Literal keeps the play with one Korean word, and Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: "믿음의 분량" at every level
decisions.reason: The faith God has given to each, by which each should judge himself or herself (meaning decision, footnoted).

decisions.choice: "nghĩ" repeated (L)
decisions.reason: Paul plays on one verb, "think", four times (m2). Literal repeats "nghĩ" so the reader hears the play; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: "lượng đức tin" at every level
decisions.reason: The measure of faith is the faith God has given to each, by which each should judge himself or herself (m3, footnoted). "Lượng" is a measured portion, which keeps the picture of God apportioning it.

source.text: καθάπερ γὰρ ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι πολλὰ μέλη ἔχομεν, τὰ δὲ μέλη πάντα οὐ τὴν αὐτὴν ἔχει πρᾶξιν, οὕτως οἱ πολλοὶ ἓν σῶμά ἐσμεν ἐν Χριστῷ, τὸ δὲ καθ’ εἷς ἀλλήλων μέλη.

records.literal_gloss: Just as for in one body many members we have, and the members all not the same have function, \v 5 so the many one body we are in Christ, and the one by one of one another members.

en.L: For just as in one body we have many members, and all the members do not have the same function, \v 5 so we, the many, are one body in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, and individually members of one another.
en.B: We have many parts in a single body, and the parts do not all have the same task. \v 5 In the same way, many as we are, we are one body in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, and each of us is a part that belongs to all the others.
en.R: A body is one body, but it has many parts, and the parts do not all do the same job. \v 5 It is the same with us. There are many of us, but we are one body because we belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. Each of us is joined to all the others.

es.L: Porque así como en un cuerpo tenemos muchos miembros, y no todos los miembros tienen la misma función, \v 5 así nosotros, los muchos, somos un cuerpo en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, y uno por uno, miembros unos de otros.
es.B: Tenemos muchas partes en un solo cuerpo, y no todas las partes tienen la misma tarea. \v 5 Del mismo modo, aunque somos muchos, somos un solo cuerpo en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, y cada uno de nosotros es una parte que pertenece a todas las demás.
es.R: Un cuerpo es uno solo, pero tiene muchas partes, y no todas las partes hacen el mismo trabajo. \v 5 Así pasa con nosotros. Somos muchos, pero somos un solo cuerpo porque pertenecemos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}. Cada uno está unido a todos los demás.

sw.L: Kwa sababu, sawa na tulivyo na viungo vingi katika mwili mmoja, na viungo vyote havifanyi kazi ileile, \v 5 ndivyo nasi, tulio wengi, tulivyo mwili mmoja katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na mmoja mmoja tu viungo sisi kwa sisi.
sw.B: Mwili mmoja una viungo vingi, na si viungo vyote vyenye kazi ileile. \v 5 Vivyo hivyo, ingawa tu wengi, sisi ni mwili mmoja katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na kila mmoja wetu ni kiungo cha wengine wote.
sw.R: Mwili ni mmoja, lakini una viungo vingi, na viungo vyote havifanyi kazi ileile. \v 5 Ndivyo ilivyo kwetu. Sisi ni wengi, lakini tu mwili mmoja kwa sababu sisi ni wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Kila mmoja wetu ameunganishwa na wengine wote.

fr.L: Car, de même que dans un seul corps nous avons beaucoup de membres, et que tous les membres n’ont pas la même fonction, \v 5 ainsi nous, les nombreux, nous sommes un seul corps {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, et, chacun pour sa part, membres les uns des autres.
fr.B: Nous avons beaucoup de membres dans un seul corps, et ces membres n’ont pas tous la même tâche. \v 5 De même, tout nombreux que nous sommes, nous formons un seul corps {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, et chacun de nous est un membre qui appartient à tous les autres.
fr.R: Un corps est un seul corps, mais il a beaucoup de parties, et ces parties ne font pas toutes le même travail. \v 5 C’est pareil pour nous. Nous sommes nombreux, mais nous formons un seul corps, parce que nous appartenons au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Chacun de nous est uni à tous les autres.

ko.L: 우리가 한 몸 안에 많은 지체를 가지고 있으나 모든 지체가 같은 기능을 가지고 있지 않은 것과 같이, \v 5 이와 같이 많은 우리가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 한 몸이요, 각각은 서로의 지체입니다.
ko.B: 우리는 한 몸 안에 많은 부분을 가지고 있지만, 그 부분들이 모두 같은 일을 하지는 않습니다. \v 5 이와 같이 우리도 수는 많지만 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 한 몸이며, 각 사람은 다른 모든 사람에게 속한 부분입니다.
ko.R: 한 몸에는 여러 부분이 있지만, 그 부분들이 모두 같은 일을 하지는 않습니다. \v 5 우리도 마찬가지입니다. 우리는 수가 많지만, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 속해 있기 때문에 한 몸입니다. 우리는 각자 다른 모든 사람과 서로 연결되어 있습니다.

vi.L: Vì như trong một thân thể chúng ta có nhiều chi thể, và các chi thể không phải đều có cùng một chức năng, \v 5 thì cũng vậy, chúng ta, là số đông, [là] một thân thể trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, và từng người là chi thể của nhau.
vi.B: Chúng ta có nhiều bộ phận trong một thân thể, và các bộ phận ấy không cùng làm một việc. \v 5 Cũng vậy, dù chúng ta là số đông, chúng ta là một thân thể trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, và mỗi người chúng ta là một bộ phận thuộc về mọi người khác.
vi.R: Một thân thể chỉ là một, nhưng có nhiều bộ phận, và các bộ phận không làm cùng một việc. \v 5 Chúng ta cũng vậy. Chúng ta có nhiều người, nhưng là một thân thể vì chúng ta thuộc về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Mỗi người chúng ta gắn liền với tất cả những người khác.

decisions.choice: members: the parts of a body, such as hands, feet and eyes
decisions.reason: The word μέλος means a limb or part of the body. Paul's picture is of a living body, as in 1 Corinthians 12:12-27, not of membership in a club.

decisions.choice: in Christ: united with Christ, the many become one body
decisions.reason: Believers are one body because each is joined to Christ (6:3-11). The unity comes from him, not from their agreement with one another.

decisions.choice: individually members of one another: each belongs to all the others
decisions.reason: The phrase καθ εἷς means "one by one". Each believer is a part that belongs to the others and needs them.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L), {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: because we belong to
decisions.reason: Readable says what "in Christ" means here: the many are one body because they are joined to him.

decisions.choice: {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} (L, B); au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} (R) (for chapters 12-16)
decisions.reason: French cannot say "en Messie", so the span for Paul's "in Christ" covers the preposition, as in Colossians and Hebrews. Elsewhere the article stays outside the span ("le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}", "du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}"), and "Jesus Christ" is "Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}" at Literal, "Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: membres (L, B); parties (R)
decisions.reason: French "membre" names both a part of the body and a member of a group, which is Paul's point, so Literal and Balanced keep it where the English Balanced says "parts". Readable says "parties", the plain word for the picture of the body.

decisions.choice: "지체" (L); "부분" (B, R) for members, as at 6:13
decisions.reason: Members are the parts of a body, such as hands, feet and eyes (meaning decision); "지체" is the church word, "부분" the everyday one.

decisions.choice: "{{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 속해 있기 때문에" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what "in Christ" means here, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "chi thể" (L); "bộ phận" (B, R), as in 6:13
decisions.reason: Members are the parts of a body (m1). The words are those settled in 6:13; "thành viên" (member of a club) would lose the picture of the body.

decisions.choice: "số đông" (L, B) for "the many", as in 5:15
decisions.reason: The Greek has the article, "the many", and Vietnamese keeps the word settled for it in 5:15; Readable says "nhiều người".

source.text: ἔχοντες δὲ χαρίσματα κατὰ τὴν χάριν τὴν δοθεῖσαν ἡμῖν διάφορα, εἴτε προφητείαν κατὰ τὴν ἀναλογίαν τῆς πίστεως, εἴτε διακονίαν ἐν τῇ διακονίᾳ, εἴτε ὁ διδάσκων ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ, εἴτε ὁ παρακαλῶν ἐν τῇ παρακλήσει, ὁ μεταδιδοὺς ἐν ἁπλότητι, ὁ προϊστάμενος ἐν σπουδῇ, ὁ ἐλεῶν ἐν ἱλαρότητι.

records.literal_gloss: Having and gifts according to the grace the having been given to us differing, whether prophecy according to the proportion of the faith, \v 7 whether service in the service, whether the [one] teaching in the teaching, \v 8 whether the [one] exhorting in the exhortation, the [one] sharing in generosity, the [one] leading with diligence, the [one] showing mercy with cheerfulness.

en.L: And having gifts that differ according to the grace given to us, if prophecy, [let us use it] in proportion to the faith; \v 7 if service, in the serving; if the one who teaches, in the teaching; \v 8 if the one who encourages, in the encouragement; the one who shares, with generosity; the one who leads, with diligence; the one who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
en.B: We have gifts that differ, according to the grace given to us. If someone's gift is prophecy, they should prophesy in proportion to their faith. \v 7 If it is serving, they should give themselves to serving; the one who teaches, to teaching; \v 8 the one who encourages, to encouraging. The one who shares should share generously; the one who leads, with eagerness; the one who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
en.R: God in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace has given us different gifts. Some have the gift of speaking messages from God. They should speak as far as their faith allows. \v 7 Some have the gift of serving. They should give themselves to serving. Some teach. They should keep at teaching. \v 8 Some encourage others. They should keep on encouraging. Those who share with others should give freely. Those who lead should work hard at it. Those who show kindness to people in need should do it gladly.

es.L: Y teniendo dones que difieren según la gracia que nos fue dada, si [es] profecía, [usémosla] conforme a la proporción de la fe; \v 7 si servicio, en el servicio; si el que enseña, en la enseñanza; \v 8 si el que exhorta, en la exhortación; el que comparte, con generosidad; el que dirige, con diligencia; el que muestra misericordia, con alegría.
es.B: Nuestros dones son distintos, conforme a la gracia que nos fue dada. Si alguien tiene el don de profecía, que profetice conforme a la fe que tiene. \v 7 Si es el de servir, que se dedique a servir; el que enseña, a enseñar; \v 8 el que anima, a animar. El que comparte, que lo haga con generosidad; el que dirige, con empeño; el que muestra misericordia, con alegría.
es.R: Dios, en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia, nos ha dado dones diferentes. Algunos tienen el don de comunicar mensajes de parte de Dios. Que lo hagan hasta donde su fe les permita. \v 7 Algunos tienen el don de servir. Que se entreguen a servir. Algunos enseñan. Que sigan enseñando. \v 8 Algunos animan a otros. Que sigan animando. Los que comparten con otros, que den con generosidad. Los que dirigen, que se esfuercen en ello. Los que ayudan a los necesitados, que lo hagan con alegría.

sw.L: Na tukiwa na karama zinazotofautiana kulingana na neema tuliyopewa, ikiwa ni unabii, [tuutumie] kwa uwiano wa imani; \v 7 ikiwa ni huduma, katika huduma; ikiwa ni yeye afundishaye, katika mafundisho; \v 8 ikiwa ni yeye atiaye moyo, katika kutia moyo; yeye agawaye, kwa ukarimu; yeye aongozaye, kwa bidii; yeye aonyeshaye rehema, kwa furaha.
sw.B: Tuna karama zinazotofautiana, kulingana na neema tuliyopewa. Ikiwa karama ya mtu ni unabii, na atoe unabii kulingana na imani yake. \v 7 Ikiwa ni kuhudumu, na ajitoe katika kuhudumu; anayefundisha, katika kufundisha; \v 8 anayetia moyo, katika kutia moyo. Anayewagawia wengine na agawe kwa ukarimu; anayeongoza, kwa juhudi; anayeonyesha rehema, kwa moyo mkunjufu.
sw.R: Mungu kwa neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ametupa karama tofauti. Wengine wana karama ya kusema ujumbe kutoka kwa Mungu. Waseme kwa kadiri imani yao inavyowawezesha. \v 7 Wengine wana karama ya kuhudumu. Wajitoe kuhudumu. Wengine wanafundisha. Waendelee kufundisha. \v 8 Wengine huwatia watu moyo. Waendelee kuwatia moyo. Wanaowagawia wengine mali zao watoe kwa ukarimu. Wanaoongoza wafanye kazi hiyo kwa bidii. Wanaowaonyesha wahitaji wema wafanye hivyo kwa furaha.

fr.L: Et ayant des dons qui diffèrent selon la grâce qui nous a été donnée, si [c’est la] prophétie, [exerçons-la] selon la proportion de la foi ; \v 7 si [c’est le] service, dans le service ; si [c’est] celui qui enseigne, dans l’enseignement ; \v 8 si [c’est] celui qui encourage, dans l’encouragement ; celui qui partage, avec générosité ; celui qui dirige, avec zèle ; celui qui exerce la miséricorde, avec joie.
fr.B: Nous avons des dons différents, selon la grâce qui nous a été donnée. Si quelqu’un a le don de prophétie, qu’il prophétise à la mesure de sa foi. \v 7 Si c’est le service, qu’il se consacre au service ; celui qui enseigne, à l’enseignement ; \v 8 celui qui encourage, à l’encouragement. Que celui qui partage le fasse avec générosité ; celui qui dirige, avec ardeur ; celui qui exerce la miséricorde, avec joie.
fr.R: Dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, Dieu nous a donné des dons différents. Certains ont le don de transmettre des messages de la part de Dieu. Qu’ils le fassent autant que leur foi le leur permet. \v 7 D’autres ont le don de servir. Qu’ils se donnent au service. Certains enseignent. Qu’ils continuent d’enseigner. \v 8 Certains encouragent les autres. Qu’ils continuent à les encourager. Ceux qui partagent avec les autres, qu’ils donnent sans compter. Ceux qui dirigent, qu’ils s’y appliquent avec ardeur. Ceux qui aident les gens dans le besoin, qu’ils le fassent avec joie.

ko.L: 우리에게 주신 은혜를 따라 우리가 서로 다른 은사들을 가지고 있으니, 예언이면 믿음의 비율에 따라 [합시다]. \v 7 섬기는 일이면 섬기는 일에, 가르치는 사람이면 가르치는 일에, \v 8 권면하는 사람이면 권면하는 일에 [힘씁시다]. 나누어 주는 사람은 너그러움으로, 다스리는 사람은 부지런함으로, 자비를 베푸는 사람은 즐거움으로 [합시다].
ko.B: 우리는 우리에게 주신 은혜에 따라 서로 다른 은사를 가지고 있습니다. 예언의 은사가 있는 사람은 자기 믿음의 정도에 맞게 예언해야 합니다. \v 7 섬기는 은사가 있는 사람은 섬기는 일에 힘써야 하고, 가르치는 사람은 가르치는 일에, \v 8 권면하는 사람은 권면하는 일에 힘써야 합니다. 나누어 주는 사람은 너그럽게 나누어 주고, 이끄는 사람은 열심을 다해 이끌고, 자비를 베푸는 사람은 기쁜 마음으로 베풀어야 합니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 그분의 은혜로 우리에게 서로 다른 은사를 주셨습니다. 어떤 사람은 하나님께 받은 말씀을 전하는 은사가 있습니다. 그런 사람은 자기 믿음이 허락하는 만큼 말씀을 전해야 합니다. \v 7 어떤 사람은 섬기는 은사가 있습니다. 그런 사람은 섬기는 일에 힘써야 합니다. 어떤 사람은 가르칩니다. 그런 사람은 가르치는 일을 꾸준히 해야 합니다. \v 8 어떤 사람은 다른 사람들을 격려합니다. 그런 사람은 계속 격려해야 합니다. 다른 사람들과 나누는 사람은 아낌없이 나누어야 합니다. 이끄는 사람은 열심히 이끌어야 합니다. 어려운 사람들에게 친절을 베푸는 사람은 기쁜 마음으로 해야 합니다.

vi.L: Và có những ân tứ khác nhau theo ân điển đã ban cho chúng ta, nếu [là] lời tiên tri, [hãy nói] tương xứng với đức tin; \v 7 nếu [là] sự phục vụ, [hãy chuyên tâm] trong sự phục vụ; nếu [là] người dạy dỗ, trong sự dạy dỗ; \v 8 nếu [là] người khích lệ, trong sự khích lệ; người chia sẻ, với lòng rộng rãi; người lãnh đạo, với sự siêng năng; người làm việc thương xót, với lòng vui vẻ.
vi.B: Chúng ta có những ân tứ khác nhau, tùy theo ân điển đã ban cho chúng ta. Nếu ai có ân tứ nói tiên tri, hãy nói tiên tri tương xứng với đức tin mình. \v 7 Nếu là phục vụ, hãy tận tâm phục vụ; ai dạy dỗ, hãy tận tâm dạy dỗ; \v 8 ai khích lệ, hãy tận tâm khích lệ. Người chia sẻ hãy chia sẻ cách rộng rãi; người lãnh đạo hãy lãnh đạo cách nhiệt tình; người làm việc thương xót hãy làm với lòng vui vẻ.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời, bởi ân điển của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đã ban cho chúng ta những món quà khác nhau. Có người được ban khả năng nói sứ điệp từ Đức Chúa Trời. Họ hãy nói trong giới hạn đức tin của mình. \v 7 Có người được ban khả năng phục vụ. Họ hãy hết lòng phục vụ. Có người dạy dỗ. Họ hãy chuyên tâm dạy dỗ. \v 8 Có người khích lệ người khác. Họ hãy cứ tiếp tục khích lệ. Ai chia sẻ với người khác hãy cho cách rộng rãi. Ai lãnh đạo hãy làm việc chăm chỉ. Ai giúp đỡ người gặp khó khăn hãy làm với lòng vui vẻ.

decisions.choice: an unfinished list: the verb is left for the reader to supply, as a command to use each gift
alternatives: a continuation of verse 5: we are members of one another, having different gifts
decisions.reason: The sentence begins with a participle, "having", and the list that follows has no main verb. The pattern "if prophecy, in proportion to faith; if service, in the service" calls for something like "let us use it". Some read the participle as continuing verse 5 instead; the meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: gifts: what God's grace gives each believer for the good of the others
decisions.reason: The word χάρισμα is built on the word for grace (χάρις), which follows it here: the gifts are grace given in different forms (1 Corinthians 12:4-11, 1 Peter 4:10).

decisions.choice: prophecy: speaking a message given by God for the church
decisions.reason: In Paul's letters prophecy is speaking what God has made known, to build up, encourage and comfort the church (1 Corinthians 14:3). It may include the future but is not limited to it.

decisions.choice: in proportion to faith: each prophet speaks as far as his or her faith reaches, and no further
alternatives: in agreement with the faith: in line with what the church believes
decisions.reason: The word ἀναλογία means proportion or agreement. Read with "a measure of faith" in verse 3, it means the prophet speaks within the faith God has given. Since "the faith" has the article, it can also mean the faith that is believed, so that prophecy must agree with it.

decisions.choice: service: practical help given to others in the church
decisions.reason: The word διακονία is the general word for serving, used of practical care such as the collection for Jerusalem (15:31). Nothing here points to a formal office.

decisions.choice: encourage: urge and strengthen others to keep going
decisions.reason: The word παρακαλέω covers urging, appeal and comfort. It is the verb Paul uses in verse 1 for his own appeal.

decisions.choice: generously: giving freely, with an undivided heart
decisions.reason: The word ἁπλότης means singleness or simplicity, and in giving it means generosity (2 Corinthians 8:2, 9:11). Both sides are in the word: giving freely and without hidden motives.

decisions.choice: the one who leads: one who stands at the head of others and cares for them
alternatives: the one who gives help or acts as patron
decisions.reason: The word προΐστημι means to stand before or at the head of others (1 Thessalonians 5:12), and it also carries the idea of caring for them. Its place between giving and showing mercy suggests leading that looks after others, perhaps as a patron; the related noun is used of Phoebe in 16:2.

decisions.choice: shows mercy: practical care for the poor, the sick and those in trouble
decisions.reason: Showing mercy means acts of kindness to people in need, done cheerfully rather than grudgingly (2 Corinthians 9:7).

decisions.choice: [let us use it]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the verb that the list implies, in brackets.

decisions.choice: should give themselves to serving / keep at teaching
alternatives: in the service, in the teaching
decisions.reason: The Greek says "in the service", "in the teaching": stay at the task. Balanced and Readable give the sense with a verb.

decisions.choice: speaking messages from God
decisions.reason: Readable says what prophecy is.

decisions.choice: show kindness to people in need
decisions.reason: Readable says what showing mercy means here.

decisions.choice: God in his grace has given us
alternatives: according to the grace given to us
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the giver, which the passive "given" implies.

decisions.choice: el que exhorta, en la exhortación
alternatives: el que anima, en el ánimo
decisions.reason: Literal uses "exhortar", the verb of Paul's own appeal in verse 1 ("exhorto"), so the link the meaning decision notes is visible. Balanced and Readable say "animar", the everyday sense here.

decisions.choice: encourager, l’encouragement
decisions.reason: The verb means to urge and strengthen others to keep going (meaning decision). "Exhorter" today sounds like a stern lecture; "encourager" carries both the urging and the strengthening.

decisions.choice: qu’il prophétise ... qu’il se consacre (no gender span)
decisions.reason: The English Balanced needs "they" for "someone"; French "quelqu’un ... il" is already generic, so no setting span is added, as the French style guide says.

decisions.choice: "[합시다]", "[힘씁시다]" (L); "... 해야 합니다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The list has no main verb; the meaning decision says it is to be supplied as a command to use each gift. Literal brackets a "let us" verb, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable say what each one should do.

decisions.choice: "은사" at every level; "예언" (L, B); "하나님께 받은 말씀을 전하다" (R)
decisions.reason: Gifts are what God's grace gives each believer (meaning decision); "은사" is the letter's word (1:11; 11:29). Prophecy is speaking a message given by God, which Readable says.

decisions.choice: "권면하다" (L, B) / "격려하다" (R); "다스리는 사람" (L) / "이끄는 사람" (B, R); "자비를 베푸는 사람" (L, B) / "어려운 사람들에게 친절을 베푸는 사람" (R)
decisions.reason: Each follows the meaning decisions: urging and strengthening others, standing at the head of others and caring for them, practical care for those in need.

decisions.choice: "ân tứ" (L, B); "món quà", "khả năng" (R)
decisions.reason: The gifts are what God's grace gives each believer for the good of others (m2), the word kept as "ân tứ" since 1:11; Readable says "món quà", as in 1:11, and names each as an ability God gives.

decisions.choice: "[hãy nói]", "[hãy chuyên tâm]" (L)
decisions.reason: The list has no verb, and the reader is meant to supply a command to use each gift (m1). Vietnamese cannot leave "nếu [là] lời tiên tri" hanging without a verb, so Literal brackets one, as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: "người lãnh đạo" at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as one who stands at the head of others and cares for them, with a footnote for "one who gives aid". "Lãnh đạo" is the plain word for one who leads; "cai quản" would sound like governing.

en.B: Let your love be real, with no pretense.
en.R: Love others truly, not just for show.

es.B: Que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} amor sea sincero, sin fingimiento.
es.R: {{plural_you:Amen|Amad}} a los demás de verdad, no solo para aparentar.

sw.B: Upendo wenu uwe wa kweli, bila kujifanya.
sw.R: Wapendeni wengine kwa dhati, si kwa kujionyesha tu.

fr.B: Que votre amour soit vrai, sans faux-semblant.
fr.R: Aimez les autres sincèrement, pas seulement en apparence.

ko.B: 여러분의 사랑은 거짓이 없는 참된 사랑이어야 합니다.
ko.R: 다른 사람들을 진심으로 사랑하십시오. 보여 주기 위해 사랑하는 척하지 마십시오.

vi.L: Tình yêu thương [phải] không giả dối.
vi.B: Hãy để tình yêu thương của anh chị em là thật, không giả vờ.
vi.R: Hãy yêu thương người khác cách chân thật, không phải chỉ để làm cảnh.

decisions.choice: love must be without pretense: a command, though the Greek has no verb
alternatives: a statement: love is without pretense
decisions.reason: The Greek has only "the love unhypocritical". In a list of commands it works as one, and it heads everything that follows to 13:10. The article points to love as the church knows it: love for one another.

decisions.choice: without pretense: real, not acted
decisions.reason: The word ἀνυπόκριτος is "un-hypocritical". A hypocrite was first a stage actor, someone playing a part. Love must not be a performance.

decisions.choice: your love / love others
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that the love meant is the readers' own love for others.

decisions.choice: "... 없어야 [합니다]" (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb, but the meaning decision reads it as a command; Literal brackets the ending that makes it one.

source.text: ἀποστυγοῦντες τὸ πονηρόν, κολλώμενοι τῷ ἀγαθῷ·

records.literal_gloss: abhorring the evil, gluing [yourselves] to the good;

en.L: Abhorring what is evil, clinging to what is good;
en.B: Loathe evil and stick to what is good.
en.R: Hate what is wrong. Hold on tight to what is good.

es.L: Aborreciendo lo malo, {{plural_you:adhiriéndose|adhiriéndoos}} a lo bueno;
es.B: {{plural_you:Detesten|Detestad}} lo malo y no {{plural_you:se despeguen|os despeguéis}} de lo bueno.
es.R: {{plural_you:Odien|Odiad}} lo que está mal. {{plural_you:Aférrense|Aferraos}} a lo que es bueno.

sw.L: Mkichukia yaliyo maovu, mkijiambatanisha na yaliyo mema;
sw.B: Lichukieni kabisa lililo baya, na mng'ang'anie lililo jema.
sw.R: Chukieni yaliyo mabaya. Shikilieni kwa nguvu yaliyo mema.

fr.L: Ayant le mal en horreur, attachés au bien ;
fr.B: Ayez le mal en horreur et attachez-vous au bien.
fr.R: Détestez ce qui est mal. Accrochez-vous à ce qui est bon.

ko.L: 악한 것을 몹시 미워하고, 선한 것에 굳게 붙어 [있으십시오].
ko.B: 악한 것을 혐오하고, 선한 것을 굳게 붙잡으십시오.
ko.R: 나쁜 것을 미워하십시오. 좋은 것을 꼭 붙잡으십시오.

vi.L: Ghê tởm điều ác, gắn bó với điều thiện;
vi.B: Hãy gớm ghét điều ác và bám chặt lấy điều thiện.
vi.R: Hãy ghét điều sai trái. Hãy giữ chặt điều tốt.

decisions.choice: participles used as commands
alternatives: participles describing what sincere love does
decisions.reason: From here to verse 13, and again in verses 16-19, Paul uses participles where commands are expected, a style also found in Jewish moral teaching. They spell out what real love looks like, and they work as commands.

decisions.choice: loathe what is evil; hold fast to what is good
decisions.reason: The word ἀποστυγέω is a strong word for hating with disgust. The word κολλάομαι means to glue or join oneself to something.

decisions.choice: the participles without "hãy" (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek uses participles as commands (m1). Literal leaves out "hãy" so that the list keeps the form of the Greek, which a Vietnamese reader still hears as instruction; Balanced and Readable say "hãy".

source.text: τῇ φιλαδελφίᾳ εἰς ἀλλήλους φιλόστοργοι, τῇ τιμῇ ἀλλήλους προηγούμενοι, τῇ σπουδῇ μὴ ὀκνηροί, τῷ πνεύματι ζέοντες, τῷ κυρίῳ δουλεύοντες, τῇ ἐλπίδι χαίροντες, τῇ θλίψει ὑπομένοντες, τῇ προσευχῇ προσκαρτεροῦντες, ταῖς χρείαις τῶν ἁγίων κοινωνοῦντες, τὴν φιλοξενίαν διώκοντες.

records.literal_gloss: In the brotherly love toward one another devoted, in the honor one another going before, \v 11 in the diligence not lazy, in the spirit boiling, the Lord serving, \v 12 in the hope rejoicing, in the affliction enduring, in the prayer persisting, \v 13 in the needs of the holy ones sharing, the hospitality pursuing.

en.L: In {{gender:love for brothers and sisters|brotherly love}} [be] devoted to one another, in honor going ahead of one another, \v 11 in diligence not lazy, in the Spirit fervent, serving the Lord, \v 12 in hope rejoicing, in affliction enduring, in prayer persevering, \v 13 sharing in the needs of the holy ones, pursuing hospitality.
en.B: Love one another warmly, as {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} in one family; take the lead in honoring one another. \v 11 Never let your eagerness flag; be on fire in the Spirit; serve the Lord. \v 12 Let your hope keep you rejoicing; hold out under trouble; keep at prayer. \v 13 Share with God's holy people in their needs, and be eager to welcome guests.
en.R: Love each other the way {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} in a family do. Be the first to show respect to one another. \v 11 Work hard and do not be lazy. Let the Spirit keep you on fire. Serve the Lord. \v 12 Be glad because of what you hope for. Be patient when trouble comes. Keep on praying. \v 13 When God's people are in need, share what you have with them. Always be ready to welcome people into your home.

es.L: En el amor fraternal, [{{plural_you:sean|sed}}] afectuosos unos con otros; en la honra, {{plural_you:adelantándose|adelantándoos}} unos a otros; \v 11 en la diligencia, no perezosos; en el Espíritu, fervientes; sirviendo al Señor; \v 12 en la esperanza, gozosos; en la aflicción, soportando; en la oración, persistiendo; \v 13 participando en las necesidades de los santos; procurando la hospitalidad.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ámense|Amaos}} unos a otros con cariño, como hermanos de una misma familia; {{plural_you:tomen|tomad}} la iniciativa en {{plural_you:honrarse|honraros}} unos a otros. \v 11 Que nunca decaiga {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} empeño; {{plural_you:sean|sed}} fervorosos en el Espíritu; {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} al Señor. \v 12 Que la esperanza {{plural_you:los|os}} mantenga gozosos; {{plural_you:manténganse|manteneos}} firmes en la aflicción; no {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} de orar. \v 13 {{plural_you:Compartan|Compartid}} lo que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} con el pueblo santo de Dios cuando pasa necesidad, y {{plural_you:estén|estad}} siempre dispuestos a recibir huéspedes.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ámense|Amaos}} unos a otros como se aman los hermanos en una familia. {{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} los primeros en mostrar respeto a los demás. \v 11 {{plural_you:Trabajen|Trabajad}} con empeño y no {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} perezosos. {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} que el Espíritu {{plural_you:los|os}} mantenga encendidos. {{plural_you:Sirvan|Servid}} al Señor. \v 12 {{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} alegres por lo que {{plural_you:esperan|esperáis}}. {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} paciencia cuando vengan los problemas. {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} orando. \v 13 Cuando el pueblo de Dios pase necesidad, {{plural_you:compartan|compartid}} con ellos lo que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}}. {{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} siempre dispuestos a recibir a otros en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} casa.

sw.L: Katika upendo wa kindugu [muwe] wenye kupendana kwa dhati ninyi kwa ninyi, katika heshima mkitanguliana, \v 11 katika bidii si wavivu, katika Roho mkiwaka, mkimtumikia Bwana, \v 12 katika tumaini mkifurahi, katika dhiki mkivumilia, katika maombi mkidumu, \v 13 mkishiriki katika mahitaji ya watakatifu, mkiufuatilia ukaribishaji wa wageni.
sw.B: Pendaneni kwa moyo kama ndugu wa familia moja; muwe wa kwanza kuheshimiana. \v 11 Bidii yenu isipungue kamwe; muwe na moto wa Roho; mtumikieni Bwana. \v 12 Tumaini lenu liwape furaha daima; vumilieni katika dhiki; msiache kuomba. \v 13 Changieni mahitaji ya watakatifu, na muwe na hamu ya kuwakaribisha wageni.
sw.R: Pendaneni kama ndugu katika familia. Muwe wa kwanza kuwaheshimu wengine. \v 11 Fanyeni kazi kwa bidii, wala msiwe wavivu. Mruhusuni Roho awajaze ari. Mtumikieni Bwana. \v 12 Furahini kwa sababu ya mambo mnayoyatumainia. Muwe wavumilivu taabu zinapokuja. Endeleeni kuomba. \v 13 Watu wa Mungu wanapokuwa na shida, washirikisheni mlicho nacho. Siku zote muwe tayari kuwakaribisha watu nyumbani kwenu.

fr.L: Dans l’amour fraternel, [soyez] pleins d’affection les uns pour les autres ; dans l’honneur, vous devançant les uns les autres ; \v 11 dans le zèle, sans paresse ; dans l’Esprit, fervents ; servant le Seigneur ; \v 12 dans l’espérance, vous réjouissant ; dans l’affliction, tenant bon ; dans la prière, persévérant ; \v 13 prenant part aux besoins des saints ; poursuivant l’hospitalité.
fr.B: Aimez-vous les uns les autres avec tendresse, comme des {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} d’une même famille ; soyez les premiers à vous honorer les uns les autres. \v 11 Ne laissez jamais faiblir votre ardeur ; soyez embrasés par l’Esprit ; servez le Seigneur. \v 12 Que l’espérance vous garde dans la joie ; tenez bon dans la détresse ; soyez assidus à la prière. \v 13 Partagez avec le peuple saint de Dieu dans ses besoins, et soyez prompts à recevoir des hôtes.
fr.R: Aimez-vous les uns les autres comme des {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} s’aiment dans une famille. Soyez les premiers à montrer du respect aux autres. \v 11 Travaillez dur, ne soyez pas paresseux. Laissez l’Esprit garder votre cœur brûlant. Servez le Seigneur. \v 12 Soyez joyeux à cause de ce que vous espérez. Soyez patients quand les difficultés arrivent. Continuez à prier. \v 13 Quand les membres du peuple de Dieu sont dans le besoin, partagez avec eux ce que vous avez. Soyez toujours prêts à recevoir des gens chez vous.

ko.L: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 사랑으로 서로 다정하게 아끼고, 존경하는 일에 서로 앞장서며, \v 11 열심을 내는 일에 게으르지 않고, 영으로 뜨거우며, 주님을 섬기며, \v 12 소망 가운데서 기뻐하며, 환난 가운데서 참으며, 기도에 꾸준히 힘쓰며, \v 13 성도들의 쓸 것을 함께 나누며, 손님 대접하기를 힘써 [하십시오].
ko.B: {{gender:형제자매|형제}}처럼 서로 따뜻하게 사랑하고, 서로 존경하는 일에 앞장서십시오. \v 11 열심을 내는 데 게으르지 말고, 성령으로 뜨거워져서 주님을 섬기십시오. \v 12 소망 가운데서 기뻐하고, 환난 가운데서 참고, 기도를 꾸준히 하십시오. \v 13 성도들이 어려울 때 그들과 함께 나누고, 손님을 힘써 대접하십시오.
ko.R: {{gender:형제자매|형제}}가 한 가족 안에서 서로 사랑하듯이 서로 사랑하십시오. 서로 존중하는 일에 먼저 나서십시오. \v 11 부지런히 일하고 게으르지 마십시오. 성령께서 여러분을 뜨겁게 하시도록 하십시오. 주님을 섬기십시오. \v 12 여러분이 바라는 것이 있으니 기뻐하십시오. 어려운 일이 닥쳐도 참으십시오. 계속 기도하십시오. \v 13 하나님의 백성이 어려울 때, 여러분이 가진 것을 그들과 나누십시오. 언제나 기꺼이 사람들을 집에 맞아들이십시오.

vi.L: Trong tình yêu thương {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, [hãy] tha thiết yêu mến nhau; trong sự tôn trọng, nhường nhau đi trước; \v 11 trong sự siêng năng, không biếng nhác; trong Thánh Linh, nồng nhiệt; phục dịch Chúa; \v 12 trong niềm hy vọng, vui mừng; trong hoạn nạn, kiên trì; trong sự cầu nguyện, bền đỗ; \v 13 chia sẻ với nhu cầu của các thánh đồ; theo đuổi việc tiếp đãi khách.
vi.B: Hãy yêu thương nhau thắm thiết như {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} trong một gia đình; hãy đi trước trong việc tôn trọng nhau. \v 11 Đừng bao giờ để lòng sốt sắng phai nhạt; hãy nồng cháy trong Thánh Linh; hãy phục dịch Chúa. \v 12 Hãy để niềm hy vọng giữ anh chị em luôn vui mừng; hãy kiên trì trong hoạn nạn; hãy bền đỗ cầu nguyện. \v 13 Hãy chia sẻ với dân thánh trong lúc họ thiếu thốn, và hãy sốt sắng tiếp đãi khách.
vi.R: Hãy thương yêu nhau như {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} ruột trong một nhà. Hãy là người đầu tiên tỏ lòng tôn trọng người khác. \v 11 Hãy làm việc chăm chỉ, đừng lười biếng. Hãy để Thánh Linh giữ cho lòng anh chị em luôn nóng cháy. Hãy phục vụ Chúa. \v 12 Hãy vui mừng vì điều anh chị em đang hy vọng. Hãy kiên nhẫn khi gặp khó khăn. Hãy cứ cầu nguyện luôn. \v 13 Khi dân của Đức Chúa Trời thiếu thốn, hãy chia sẻ với họ những gì anh chị em có. Hãy luôn sẵn lòng đón tiếp người khác vào nhà mình.

decisions.choice: the warm love of family members, shown to fellow believers
decisions.reason: The word φιλαδελφία is love between brothers and sisters, and φιλόστοργος is the affection of family. Paul uses both for believers, who are God's family.

decisions.choice: take the lead in honoring one another
alternatives: prefer one another in honor: think others more worthy of honor than oneself
decisions.reason: The word προηγέομαι means to go first or lead the way, and it can also mean to consider others better. Either way, believers are to be eager to honor others.

decisions.choice: on fire in the Spirit: burning with zeal that the Holy Spirit gives
alternatives: fervent in your own spirit: eager and wholehearted
decisions.reason: "Boiling in spirit" may refer to the believer's own spirit, as of Apollos in Acts 18:25. Next to "serving the Lord", and after Paul's teaching on the Spirit in chapter 8, it more likely refers to the Holy Spirit, who stirs that zeal. The two are not far apart.

decisions.choice: serving the Lord
alternatives: serving the time (making the most of the present moment)
decisions.reason: Some early Western manuscripts read a word meaning "time" or "opportunity" in place of κυρίῳ; the two words look alike. Most manuscripts, including the earliest, read "the Lord", which SBLGNT follows. Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: serving: serving as slaves serve a master
decisions.reason: The word δουλεύω is the verb of slavery: believers belong to the Lord, as 6:22 and 14:18 say.

decisions.choice: rejoicing in hope: hope is the reason for the joy
decisions.reason: The hope is the hope of glory (5:2, 8:24-25), and it gives joy even in trouble, as the next phrase says.

decisions.choice: the holy ones: God's people, the believers
decisions.reason: "Holy ones" are those God has set apart as his own (1:7). Here they are believers in need, perhaps including those in Jerusalem (15:25-26).

decisions.choice: pursue hospitality: go out of your way to welcome guests, especially travelers
decisions.reason: The word φιλοξενία is love of strangers, welcoming travelers and visiting believers into one's home. "Pursue" (διώκω) means to seek it eagerly; the same verb begins verse 14, where it means to persecute.

decisions.choice: {{gender:love for brothers and sisters|brotherly love}} (L); {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The love meant is for all fellow believers; the reader can choose the traditional wording.

decisions.choice: never let your eagerness flag
decisions.reason: Balanced states the double negative positively.

decisions.choice: God's holy people (B); God's people (R)
decisions.reason: As at 1:7.

decisions.choice: amor fraternal; como hermanos
decisions.reason: Like "hermanos" (verse 1), "fraternal" covers the love of all members of the family, so Spanish has no gender span here.

decisions.choice: ukaribishaji wa wageni / kuwakaribisha wageni
decisions.reason: "Ukarimu" can mean hospitality, but in verse 8 it renders generosity in giving. To keep the two apart, hospitality here is said as welcoming guests.

decisions.choice: l’amour fraternel, with no gender span (L); {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} (B, R)
alternatives: {{gender:l’amour pour les frères et sœurs|l’amour fraternel}}
decisions.reason: The English Literal needs a span because "brotherly love" names only brothers. French "l’amour fraternel" is the ordinary word for love between brothers and sisters alike, so it needs none; Balanced and Readable, which name the family members, carry the span.

decisions.choice: les saints (L); le peuple saint de Dieu (B); le peuple de Dieu (R) (for chapters 12-16)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians: the word means God's people, the believers (meaning decision). French "les saints" suggests people of exceptional holiness, so Balanced and Readable say who they are.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:형제자매|형제}} 사랑" (L); "{{gender:형제자매|형제}}처럼" (B); "{{gender:형제자매|형제}}가 한 가족 안에서 ... 사랑하듯이" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is love among brothers, shown to fellow believers (meaning decision); the gender span lets the reader choose the inclusive or the traditional word, as for the readers through the letter.

decisions.choice: "영으로" (L); "성령으로" (B); "성령께서 ... 뜨겁게 하시도록" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads this as zeal that the Holy Spirit gives, and footnotes the reading "in your spirit". Literal keeps the open "영", as at 7:6; Balanced and Readable follow the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: "소망" at every level (R "바라는 것" as the object); "환난" (L, B) / "어려운 일" (R), as at 5:3; "성도들" (L, B) / "하나님의 백성" (R), as at 1:1 and 8:27
decisions.reason: The letter's fixed words for each level.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}" (L); "như {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The love meant is the warm love of a family shown to fellow believers (m1). Vietnamese says it with the word for brothers and sisters, under the gender setting used for this word through the letter; "tình huynh đệ" is male only.

decisions.choice: "trong Thánh Linh", capitalised; "phục dịch Chúa" (L, B), "phục vụ" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the spirit as the Holy Spirit who gives this zeal, with a footnote for the believer's own spirit; Vietnamese follows it with "Thánh Linh". The verb for serving the Lord is the one kept as "phục dịch" in 7:6 (m5).

decisions.choice: "các thánh đồ" (L); "dân thánh" (B); "dân của Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: The holy ones are God's people (m6), with the forms of 1:7 and 8:27.

source.text: εὐλογεῖτε τοὺς διώκοντας, εὐλογεῖτε καὶ μὴ καταρᾶσθε.

records.literal_gloss: Bless the [ones] persecuting, bless and not curse.

en.L: Bless those who persecute [you]; bless and do not curse.
en.B: Bless the people who persecute you. Bless them, and do not curse them.
en.R: Pray for God's blessing on people who treat you cruelly. Pray for good things for them, and never call down harm on them.

es.L: {{plural_you:Bendigan|Bendecid}} a los que [{{plural_you:los|os}}] persiguen; {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} y no {{plural_you:maldigan|maldigáis}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Bendigan|Bendecid}} a quienes {{plural_you:los|os}} persiguen. {{plural_you:Bendíganlos|Bendecidlos}}, y no los {{plural_you:maldigan|maldigáis}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Pidan|Pedid}} a Dios que bendiga a la gente que {{plural_you:los|os}} trata con crueldad. {{plural_you:Pidan|Pedid}} cosas buenas para ellos, y nunca {{plural_you:pidan|pidáis}} que les venga ningún mal.

sw.L: Wabarikini wale wanaowatesa; barikini, na msitoe laana.
sw.B: Wabarikini watu wanaowatesa. Wabarikini, wala msiwalaani.
sw.R: Mwombeni Mungu awabariki watu wanaowatendea ukatili. Waombeeni mambo mema, wala msiwaombee mabaya kamwe.

fr.L: Bénissez ceux qui [vous] persécutent ; bénissez et ne maudissez pas.
fr.B: Bénissez ceux qui vous persécutent. Bénissez-les, ne les maudissez pas.
fr.R: Demandez à Dieu de bénir les gens qui vous traitent avec cruauté. Priez pour qu’il leur arrive du bien, et n’appelez jamais le malheur sur eux.

ko.L: 박해하는 사람들을 축복하십시오. 축복하고 저주하지 마십시오.
ko.B: 여러분을 박해하는 사람들을 축복하십시오. 축복하고, 저주하지 마십시오.
ko.R: 여러분을 못살게 구는 사람들에게 하나님께서 복을 주시기를 기도하십시오. 그들에게 좋은 일이 있기를 빌고, 절대로 그들에게 해가 내리기를 빌지 마십시오.

vi.L: Hãy chúc phước cho những người bắt bớ [anh chị em]; hãy chúc phước, và đừng nguyền rủa.
vi.B: Hãy chúc phước cho những người bắt bớ anh chị em. Hãy chúc phước cho họ, đừng nguyền rủa họ.
vi.R: Hãy cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời ban phước cho những người đối xử tàn ác với anh chị em. Hãy cầu xin điều tốt lành cho họ, và đừng bao giờ cầu cho họ gặp điều xấu.

decisions.choice: those who persecute
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "you" after διώκοντας. Some early ones, followed by SBLGNT, do not. The meaning is the same, since the readers' own persecutors are meant. Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: the teaching of Jesus: bless those who curse you
decisions.reason: Paul echoes Jesus' teaching in Luke 6:27-28 and Matthew 5:44 without quoting it. To bless is to ask God's good for someone; to curse is to call down harm on them.

decisions.choice: those who persecute: those who hunt down or harass others
decisions.reason: The participle of διώκω is the same verb as "pursue" in verse 13: believers pursue hospitality, and others pursue them.

decisions.choice: pray for God's blessing / never call down harm
decisions.reason: Readable says what blessing and cursing are.

decisions.choice: "축복하다" (L, B); "하나님께서 복을 주시기를 기도하다" (R); "저주하다" (L, B); "해가 내리기를 빌다" (R)
decisions.reason: To bless is to ask God's good for someone; Readable says so, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "chúc phước", "nguyền rủa" (L, B)
decisions.reason: To bless here is to speak a blessing over someone, asking God's good for them; "chúc phước" is that, while "ban phước" is what God does, which Readable names. "Nguyền rủa" is the word for curse in 9:3.

source.text: χαίρειν μετὰ χαιρόντων, κλαίειν μετὰ κλαιόντων.

records.literal_gloss: To rejoice with rejoicing [ones], to weep with weeping [ones].

en.L: Rejoice with those who rejoice, weep with those who weep.
en.B: Share the joy of those who are glad, and the tears of those who weep.
en.R: When others are happy, be happy with them. When others are sad and crying, cry with them.

es.L: {{plural_you:Gócense|Gozaos}} con los que se gozan; {{plural_you:lloren|llorad}} con los que lloran.
es.B: {{plural_you:Compartan|Compartid}} el gozo de los que están contentos y las lágrimas de los que lloran.
es.R: Cuando otros estén felices, {{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}} con ellos. Cuando otros estén tristes y lloren, {{plural_you:lloren|llorad}} con ellos.

sw.L: Furahini pamoja na wanaofurahi, lieni pamoja na wanaolia.
sw.B: Shirikini furaha ya walio na furaha, na machozi ya wanaolia.
sw.R: Wengine wakiwa na furaha, furahini pamoja nao. Wengine wakiwa na huzuni na kulia, lieni pamoja nao.

fr.L: Réjouissez-vous avec ceux qui se réjouissent, pleurez avec ceux qui pleurent.
fr.B: Partagez la joie de ceux qui sont heureux et les larmes de ceux qui pleurent.
fr.R: Quand les autres sont heureux, soyez heureux avec eux. Quand les autres sont tristes et pleurent, pleurez avec eux.

ko.L: 기뻐하는 사람들과 함께 기뻐하고, 우는 사람들과 함께 우십시오.
ko.B: 기뻐하는 사람들과 함께 기뻐하고, 우는 사람들과 함께 울어 주십시오.
ko.R: 다른 사람들이 기뻐할 때 함께 기뻐하십시오. 다른 사람들이 슬퍼서 울 때 함께 우십시오.

vi.L: Vui với những người vui mừng, khóc với những người khóc lóc.
vi.B: Hãy chia sẻ niềm vui với người đang vui, và chia sẻ nước mắt với người đang khóc.
vi.R: Khi người khác vui, hãy vui với họ. Khi người khác buồn và khóc, hãy khóc với họ.

decisions.choice: infinitives used as commands
decisions.reason: The two infinitives, "to rejoice" and "to weep", work as commands in this list, as the participles do.

decisions.choice: share the joy of those who are glad
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps both parts of the saying with plain words.

decisions.choice: commands
decisions.reason: The Greek has infinitives used as commands (see the meaning decision). A bare Spanish infinitive can also command, but it reads as a sign or a rule; Literal uses commands, as the English does.

decisions.choice: réjouissez-vous ... pleurez (imperatives)
decisions.reason: The Greek uses infinitives as commands (meaning decision). A French infinitive can give an order, but in a letter it reads like a notice or a recipe, so Literal uses the imperative, as the English does.

source.text: τὸ αὐτὸ εἰς ἀλλήλους φρονοῦντες, μὴ τὰ ὑψηλὰ φρονοῦντες ἀλλὰ τοῖς ταπεινοῖς συναπαγόμενοι.

records.literal_gloss: The same toward one another thinking, not the high things thinking but with the lowly being carried along.

en.L: Thinking the same toward one another, not thinking high things but associating with the lowly.
en.B: Be of one mind toward each other. Do not aim at lofty things, but be glad to go along with people of low position.
en.R: Try to think the same way as one another. Do not be proud. Be glad to spend time with people others look down on.

es.L: Pensando lo mismo unos hacia otros, no pensando cosas altas, sino {{plural_you:dejándose|dejándoos}} llevar con los humildes.
es.B: {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} un mismo sentir los unos para con los otros. No {{plural_you:aspiren|aspiréis}} a grandezas, sino {{plural_you:acompañen|acompañad}} con gusto a la gente sencilla.
es.R: {{plural_you:Procuren|Procurad}} pensar de la misma manera unos y otros. No {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} orgullosos. {{plural_you:Disfruten|Disfrutad}} de la compañía de la gente a la que otros desprecian.

sw.L: Mkifikiri lilelile mmoja kwa mwingine, bila kuyafikiri mambo ya juu, bali mkiambatana na walio wa hali ya chini.
sw.B: Muwe na mtazamo mmoja kati yenu. Msitamani mambo ya fahari, bali furahini kuandamana na watu wa hali ya chini.
sw.R: Jitahidini kufikiri kwa namna moja ninyi kwa ninyi. Msiwe na kiburi. Furahini kukaa na watu ambao wengine huwadharau.

fr.L: Ayant les mêmes pensées les uns envers les autres, ne pensant pas aux choses élevées, mais vous associant aux humbles.
fr.B: Soyez unis dans vos pensées les uns envers les autres. Ne visez pas les grandeurs, mais faites volontiers route avec les gens modestes.
fr.R: Essayez de penser de la même manière les uns et les autres. Ne soyez pas orgueilleux. Soyez contents de passer du temps avec les gens que les autres méprisent.

ko.L: 서로 같은 생각을 하며, 높은 것들을 생각하지 말고 낮은 사람들과 함께 어울리십시오.
ko.B: 서로 한마음이 되십시오. 높은 것을 바라보지 말고, 낮은 처지에 있는 사람들과 기꺼이 어울리십시오.
ko.R: 서로 같은 마음을 품으려고 애쓰십시오. 교만하지 마십시오. 다른 사람들이 업신여기는 사람들과 기쁘게 함께 지내십시오.

vi.L: Đồng tâm với nhau, không nghĩ đến những điều cao sang, nhưng hòa mình với những người thấp kém.
vi.B: Hãy đồng tâm với nhau. Đừng nhắm đến những điều cao sang, nhưng hãy vui lòng đồng hành với những người có địa vị thấp kém.
vi.R: Hãy cố gắng suy nghĩ giống nhau. Đừng kiêu ngạo. Hãy vui lòng gần gũi những người mà người khác coi thường.

decisions.choice: think the same toward one another: be of one mind, with the same regard for each
decisions.reason: The word φρονέω is the verb of verse 3. To think the same toward one another is to share one aim and to regard each other alike, not to agree on everything (15:5, Philippians 2:2).

decisions.choice: associate with lowly people
decisions.reason: The form ταπεινοῖς can be masculine (lowly people) or neuter (lowly things). Set against "high things" it could be neuter, but Paul elsewhere uses the word for people, and the verse is about how believers treat one another.

decisions.choice: be glad to go along with
decisions.reason: The word συναπάγομαι means to be carried away along with someone; here it is a willing choice to be in their company.

decisions.choice: "낮은 사람들" (L); "낮은 처지에 있는 사람들" (B); "다른 사람들이 업신여기는 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as lowly people and footnotes "lowly tasks"; Korean has to choose, and follows it.

decisions.choice: "những người thấp kém" at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as lowly people, with a footnote for lowly tasks. Vietnamese must choose people or things, and follows the meaning decision.

en.L: Do not be wise in your own [opinion].
en.R: Do not think you are wiser than everyone else.

es.R: No {{plural_you:piensen|penséis}} que {{plural_you:son|sois}} más sabios que todos los demás.

sw.L: Msiwe wenye hekima kwa [maoni] yenu wenyewe.
sw.R: Msidhani kwamba mna hekima kuliko watu wengine wote.

fr.L: Ne soyez pas sages à vos propres [yeux].
fr.B: Ne vous prenez pas pour des sages.
fr.R: Ne pensez pas que vous êtes plus sages que tous les autres.

ko.L: 여러분 스스로 [보기에] 지혜로운 사람이 되지 마십시오.
ko.R: 자기가 다른 사람들보다 더 지혜롭다고 생각하지 마십시오.

vi.L: Đừng trở nên khôn ngoan theo [ý] riêng mình.
vi.B: Đừng tự cho mình là khôn ngoan.
vi.R: Đừng nghĩ mình khôn ngoan hơn mọi người.

decisions.choice: Proverbs 3:7
decisions.reason: Paul echoes Proverbs 3:7, "Do not be wise in your own eyes". The phrase "in yourselves" means in your own opinion, as in 11:25.

decisions.choice: à vos propres [yeux]
decisions.reason: "Sage à ses propres yeux" is the French idiom for the Greek "wise beside yourselves" (Proverbs 3:7 in the meaning decision); the English supplies "opinion" for the same reason.

source.text: μηδενὶ κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ ἀποδιδόντες· προνοούμενοι καλὰ ἐνώπιον πάντων ἀνθρώπων·

records.literal_gloss: To no one evil for evil repaying; taking thought for good things before all men;

en.L: Repaying no one evil for evil; taking thought for what is good in the sight of all {{gender:people|men}};
en.B: Do not pay anyone back with evil for the evil done to you. Plan ahead to do what everyone recognizes as good.
en.R: If someone does wrong to you, do not do wrong back. Think ahead about how to do what everyone will see is right.

es.L: No devolviendo a nadie mal por mal; procurando lo bueno delante de {{gender:todas las personas|todos los hombres}};
es.B: A nadie le {{plural_you:devuelvan|devolváis}} mal por el mal que {{plural_you:les|os}} haya hecho. {{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} de antemano cómo hacer lo que todos reconocen como bueno.
es.R: Si alguien {{plural_you:les|os}} hace daño, no le {{plural_you:devuelvan|devolváis}} el daño. {{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} con tiempo cómo hacer lo que todos verán que es correcto.

sw.L: Bila kumlipa mtu yeyote ovu kwa ovu; mkiyafikiria mapema yaliyo mema mbele ya watu wote;
sw.B: Msimrudishie mtu yeyote uovu kwa uovu aliowatendea. Pangeni mapema kutenda yale ambayo kila mtu anayatambua kuwa mema.
sw.R: Mtu akiwakosea, msimrudishie ubaya. Fikirini mapema jinsi ya kutenda yale ambayo kila mtu ataona ni mema.

fr.L: Ne rendant à personne le mal pour le mal ; vous souciant de ce qui est bien devant {{gender:tous les êtres humains|tous les hommes}} ;
fr.B: Ne rendez à personne le mal pour le mal qu’on vous a fait. Pensez à l’avance à faire ce que tous reconnaissent comme bien.
fr.R: Si quelqu’un vous fait du mal, ne lui rendez pas le mal. Réfléchissez d’avance à la façon de faire ce que tout le monde verra comme juste.

ko.L: 아무에게도 악을 악으로 갚지 말고, 모든 사람 앞에서 선한 일을 미리 생각하십시오.
ko.B: 누구에게도 악을 악으로 갚지 마십시오. 모든 사람이 선하다고 인정하는 일을 하도록 미리 마음을 쓰십시오.
ko.R: 누가 여러분에게 잘못해도, 여러분은 똑같이 잘못으로 갚지 마십시오. 모든 사람이 보기에 옳은 일을 할 방법을 미리 생각하십시오.

vi.L: Không trả điều ác thay cho điều ác cho bất cứ ai; lo nghĩ đến điều tốt trước mặt mọi người;
vi.B: Đừng lấy điều ác đáp lại ai vì điều ác họ đã làm cho anh chị em. Hãy tính trước để làm những gì mọi người đều thấy là tốt.
vi.R: Nếu ai làm điều sai trái với anh chị em, đừng làm điều sai trái lại với họ. Hãy nghĩ trước cách làm những điều mà mọi người đều thấy là đúng.

decisions.choice: Proverbs 3:4
decisions.reason: The words echo the old Greek translation of Proverbs 3:4, "take thought for what is good before the Lord and before people". Paul uses the same words in 2 Corinthians 8:21.

decisions.choice: take care to do what all people recognize as good
alternatives: do good things openly, in front of everyone
decisions.reason: The word προνοέω means to think ahead or take care. The word καλός is what is right and honorable. Paul means conduct that even outsiders can see is good.

decisions.choice: {{gender:people|men}}
decisions.reason: The word means people in general.

decisions.choice: everyone
decisions.reason: "Everyone" is already inclusive, so it needs no setting.

decisions.choice: watu wote, no setting
decisions.reason: "Watu" already means people of both sexes; "wanaume" would mean males only and change the meaning, so Swahili has no gender span where the English Literal has one.

decisions.choice: {{gender:tous les êtres humains|tous les hommes}} (L); tous, tout le monde (B, R), with no span
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general. Literal keeps the noun and carries the setting; Balanced and Readable say "tous" and "tout le monde", which are already inclusive, as the English says "everyone".

decisions.choice: "모든 사람" with no gender span, here and in verse 18
